name: image-poster
description: Example Executa v2 image plugin — generates a poster image via reverse image/generate, optionally edits it via image/edit, and re-uploads the result via host/uploadFile.
_comment: The `distribution` block with active=local makes `anna-app apps push` auto-install a local dev shim at ~/.anna/executa/bin/<minted-tool_id> (installLocalBundledShims), so Rediscover Local finds and runs it. Do NOT pin `executable_name` in the local profile — nexus lookup is `executable_name or tool_id`, and it must fall back to the minted tool_id. For production, add a `binary` profile (PyInstaller + binary_urls, see focus-session-python) and flip `active` or use `--profile`.
